findings.problem: For 'to think, have an opinion, as in I think so', denken (Ich denke schon) and meinen are just as natural as glauben, so the hint leaves more than one right answer.
findings.fix: hint: have an opinion, as in I think so (not denken; the verb that also means to believe)

back.target: to believe, to think (that something is so)
back.example: I think it's raining today / I think it'll rain today.

note: The new hint points to the word's other meaning, but it doesn't give away the card's other prompt ("to believe").
